reviews.review_msg: Kendra was a kind professor, and the course content was easy to grasp. Lectures can be difficult to follow, but they mainly cover the readings anyway. Participation (as in discussion posts) and attendance are weighted heavily, so I would definitely recommend going to class. Honestly, if you understand the gist of the course it's easy to do well

This class was super interesting and Dr. Strauss is probably one of my favourite profs!! She is super caring, approachable and gives good feedback. Her marking is fair as long as you put effort into your work. Would highly recommend this course if you are interested in the issues that arise from capitalism and how it impacts inequalities at work.
